name: Resignation - Direct Manager Assignment
script:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PF HR05 Resignation Request
# Controls:
# (A) Auto-fill direct_manager_user + Auto-Assign ToDo on Submitted
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when state changes TO Accepted
# (D) Notice Period validation when moving TO Accepted
# Event: Validate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: get Direct Manager User (email) from Employee.reports_to.user_id
# ------------------------------------------------------------
report_user = None

if doc.employee:
    reports_to_emp = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "reports_to")
    if reports_to_emp:
        report_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", reports_to_emp, "user_id")

# Keep direct_manager_user populated (if field exists)
    if not doc.direct_manager_user and report_user:
        doc.direct_manager_user = report_user

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (A) Auto-Assign ToDo when moving to Submitted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Submitted" and new_state == "Submitted":

    if not report_user:
        frappe.throw(
            "لا يمكن إرسال الطلب لأن المدير المباشر غير محدد.\n"
            "يرجى التأكد من Reports To في Employee وأن المدير لديه User ID."
        )

    # Avoid duplicate assignment
    already_assigned = frappe.db.exists("ToDo", {
        "reference_type": doc.doctype,
        "reference_name": doc.name,
        "allocated_to": report_user,
        "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]
    })

    if not already_assigned:
        todo = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "ToDo",
            "allocated_to": report_user,  # assign to direct manager user
            "reference_type": doc.doctype,
            "reference_name": doc.name,
            "description": "Resignation Request requires your recommendation.",
            "priority": "Medium",
            "status": "Open"
        })
        todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state == "Submitted" and new_state == "Manager Recommended":
    manager_user = doc.direct_manager_user or report_user
    if not manager_user:
        frappe.throw("المدير المباشر غير محدد في الطلب (direct_manager_user).")

    if frappe.session.user != manager_user:
        frappe.throw(
            "لا يمكنك تنفيذ (Recommend Approval).\n"
            "هذا الطلب مخصص للمدير المباشر فقط."
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (D) Notice Period validation ONLY when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":
    # Mandatory fields (adjust fieldnames to your HR05)
    if not doc.request_date or not doc.proposed_last_day or not doc.notice_period_days:
        frappe.throw(
            "يرجى تعبئة Request Date و Proposed Last Working Day و Notice Period Days قبل قبول الاستقالة."
        )

    request_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.request_date)
    last_day = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.proposed_last_day)
    days_diff = (last_day - request_date).days

    if days_diff < int(doc.notice_period_days or 0):
        # Requires exception attachment
        if not doc.get("notice_exception_attachment"):
            frappe.throw(
                f"لا يمكن قبول الاستقالة لأن فترة الإشعار غير مستوفاة.\n"
                f"المطلوب: {doc.notice_period_days} يوم، المتحقق: {days_diff} يوم.\n"
                "يرجى إرفاق كتاب/موافقة استثناء في حقل Notice Period Exception Attachment."
            )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":

    # If already linked, do nothing
    if doc.get("employee_separation_case"):
        pass
    else:
        # If a case already exists for this HR05, link it
        existing_case = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Employee Separation Case",
            {"reference_no": doc.name},
            "name"
        )

        if existing_case:
            doc.employee_separation_case = existing_case
        else:
            case = frappe.new_doc("Employee Separation Case")

            case.employee = doc.employee
            case.case_type = "Resignation"
            case.reference_no = doc.name
            case.reference_date = doc.request_date
            case.effective_date = doc.proposed_last_working_day
            case.reason = doc.reason

            # Link back (adjust to your fieldname in Employee Separation Case)
            if case.meta.has_field("source_hr05"):
                case.source_hr05 = doc.name

            case.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            doc.case = case.name

name: diwan autonumber
get USD - SPY exchange rate
script:
# Server Script (Scheduler Event: Daily)
import requests, frappe
from frappe.utils import today


url = "https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/312eeeea791412de64878cfa/latest/USD"
res = requests.get(url).json()
for to_curr, rate in res["conversion_rates"].items():
    if to_curr == "SYP":
        inv = 1 / rate  
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Currency Exchange",
            "date": today(),
            "from_currency": to_curr,
            "to_currency": "USD",
            "exchange_rate": inv,
            "for_buying": 1,
            "for_selling": 1
        }).insert(ignore_if_duplicate=True)

name: Notify Attendees
script:
# Trigger only when status changes to Scheduled
if doc.status == "Scheduled" and doc.get_db_value("status") != "Scheduled":
    for row in doc.attendees:  # child table fieldname
        if not row.employee:
            continue

        # Get the linked system user from Employee
        user_id = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", row.employee, "user_id")
        if not user_id:
            continue

        # Create an in-app notification
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Notification Log",
            "subject": f"Exit Interview Scheduled: {doc.name}",
            "email_content": f"You have an Exit Interview scheduled. Document: {doc.name}",
            "for_user": user_id,
            "type": "Alert",
            "document_type": doc.doctype,
            "document_name": doc.name,
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.db.commit()

script:
# HR09 - Final Dues Statement
# Block approving HR09 unless HR08 (Clearance) for same case is Approved

CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE = "Clearance"  # <-- عدلها لاسم DocType الكليرانس الحقيقي عندك
REQUIRED_STATE = "Approved"              # <-- اسم حالة الاعتماد في Workflow

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

# Trigger only when moving to Approved
if old_state != REQUIRED_STATE and new_state == REQUIRED_STATE:

    if not doc.case:
        frappe.throw("لا يمكن اعتماد كشف المستحقات بدون اختيار Case.")

    # Get Clearance document for same case
    clearance_name = frappe.db.get_value(CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE, {"case": doc.case}, "name")

    if not clearance_name:
        frappe.throw("لا يمكن اعتماد كشف المستحقات (HR09) لأنه لا يوجد براءة ذمة (HR08) لهذه الحالة (Case).")

    clearance_state = frappe.db.get_value(CLEARANCE_DOCTYPE, clearance_name, "workflow_state")

    if clearance_state != REQUIRED_STATE:
        frappe.throw("لا يمكن اعتماد كشف المستحقات (HR09) إلا بعد اعتماد براءة الذمة (HR08).")
